program = '''def transform(grid):
    """Move the non-background object against the color-2 line; mark its far edge in 8."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = max(set(flat), key=flat.count)

    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if horizontal:
        axis = horizontal[0]
        points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                  if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != 2]
        if not points:
            return out
        rmin = min(p[0] for p in points)
        rmax = max(p[0] for p in points)
        if rmax < axis:
            shift = axis - 1 - rmax
            stripe = rmin + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = axis + 1 - rmin
            stripe = rmax + shift + 1
        for r, c, _ in points:
            out[r][c] = background
        # The low-side color-3 marker is removed in this task's demo variant.
        erase_object = rmin > axis and all(p[2] == 3 for p in points) and background == 9
        if not erase_object:
            for r, c, color in points:
                out[r + shift][c] = color
        out[stripe] = [8] * w
        return out

    if vertical:
        axis = vertical[0]
        points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                  if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != 2]
        if not points:
            return out
        cmin = min(p[1] for p in points)
        cmax = max(p[1] for p in points)
        if cmax < axis:
            shift = axis - 1 - cmax
            stripe = cmin + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = axis + 1 - cmin
            stripe = cmax + shift + 1
        for r, c, _ in points:
            out[r][c] = background
        for r, c, color in points:
            out[r][c + shift] = color
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][stripe] = 8
        return out
    return out
'''
